provenance.note: Hyperparameters pinned verbatim from the official Alpha158 benchmark workflows. No tuning. MASTER not included: no Qlib-contrib implementation exists at v0.9.6 or main (checked 2026-10-18).

data_convention.features: clean CSI300 panel (Alpha158 columns) as consumed by every arm; subset = FilterCol col_list below, verbatim from the LSTM Alpha158 ts workflow; no extra infer processors (the clean panel is already the W1-verified processed input)
data_convention.label: z_r1 (clean 1-day label, close(t+2)/close(t+1)-1, cross-sectionally z-scored; same definition as the ridge/LightGBM r1 cells of Section 8A). Qlib's own CSRankNorm label processor is NOT re-applied; noted in the benchmark README.
data_convention.seed_policy: single run per model. LSTM/GRU/ALSTM/XGBoost/DoubleEnsemble: torch/np/lgb seeds = 1. Transformer keeps its config seed 0 (the only seed appearing in the official yaml).

Transformer.note: all other hyperparameters = class defaults of qlib v0.9.6 pytorch_transformer_ts.TransformerModel

reported_edge_caution: Qlib's published benchmark numbers use train 2008-2014 / valid 2015-2016 / test 2017-2020-08 and the qlib data handler; any comparison to published IC/excess must state the different windows and pipeline (this study: clean panel, train 2008-2018, valid 2019-2020, rule selection 2021-2022).
